amendment_timing: After Python unit tests and before creation or execution of TAM parity fixtures.
reason: The originally recorded tam_mml_wle2_deparse_sha256 could not be reproduced from the installed TAM 4.3-25 namespace. The original plan remains unchanged; this amendment freezes an explicit reproducible calculation before cross-engine results exist.

reproducible_source_identity.calculation: digest::digest(paste(deparse(TAM::tam.mml.wle2), collapse='\n'), algo='sha256', serialize=FALSE) with R deparse default width.cutoff=60
